reason: Room: sky_check (src/sky.6502, included from render.6502) is in bank 4 in every SKY_HELI build, and bank 4 is ASSERTed below REN_BASE (&B400, src/main.6502 line 151). The candidate grows sky_check from 51 to 98 bytes (+47 by my count; the claim says +49). The shipping build ends bank 4 at &B37D (131 free) but the gameplay builds put shield_hi and sky_edges at bank 4's end: build/strykers-gameplay.lst (make gameplay, the published gameplay disc, 2026-10-23 01:23) has SKIP PAD_END at &B3F6, 10 bytes free, as does the hud_rupture flag set; the other full gameplay sets end at &B3C4 (60 free). +47 overruns the gameplay build by 37 bytes: 'bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace' and the build fails. The logic itself checks out (sky_row preserves X and returns A = sky_skip with Z from it; whole rows have rt = 7 and ry a multiple of 8 below 128, so Y = 8k+7; ASL/ASL/ADC/SBC #4 gives 5*(skip-1) with C set; sky_q is stored fresh by sky_draw/sky_zero before they read it; the self-modified BRA is in bank 4 sideways RAM above &9000, not under ANDY), but it does not fit its region in all the builds the project ships.
